states.label: matched
states.d: joined to an n_TOF bunch and the wall+plastic coincidence measured at or above the acceptance bar for the pulse's triggers

states.label: low coincidence
states.d: joined, coincidence measured but below the acceptance bar -- correctly joined, usable, kept out of MATCHED by the bar

states.label: coincidence not measured
states.d: joined but the product predates the per-pulse arrays

states.label: too few triggers
states.d: joined, but fewer than 10 triggers in the burst -- nothing to judge on

states.label: n_TOF not recording
states.d: a real beam pulse in a gap of the n_TOF DAQ (run transition, reset, one 25-min stop) -- no n_TOF data exists; understood and irrecoverable

states.label: not joined
states.d: a beam pulse the join left without a bunch number

states.label: segment failed
states.d: the segment's join refused (no candidate lock reached the coincidence bar)

states.label: not attempted
